description: Depth-2 PAC projection produces curl operation and Faraday tensor

results.depth_2_tensor: T_ij from PAC tree at depth 2 has rank-2 structure
results.curl_equivalence: In 3D, antisymmetric rank-2 tensor T_[ij] is dual to the curl via epsilon_ijk
results.faraday_identification: F_μν = ∂_μ A_ν − ∂_ν A_μ has identical structure to T_[ij]
results.key_insight: The MED depth limit (<=2) is exactly what produces rank-2 antisymmetric tensors. Higher depths would give higher-rank tensors that don't correspond to known gauge fields.
results.conclusion: Electromagnetic field tensor emerges from the antisymmetric sector of PAC depth-2 projection. The curl operation is not assumed but derived from the depth constraint.
